beats.summary: David confronts Andy about lying regarding his whereabouts for three months.

evidence.snippet: David Wallace: …No, you lied to me Andy. You pretended to be in this office for three months and you were sailing on your boat!
David: Really? "Hey David, all is good in Scranton PA."

beats.summary: Andy reveals he is struggling emotionally after Erin dumped him and misses his beard.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Erin just dumped me and I can't remember any of the aha moments I had on the boat, and I know it sounds weird to say but I really miss my beard.
Andy (Crying): Ok, we ready? Don't use that part. Last week, Erin told me that our relationship would be proceeding without me.

beats.summary: Erin has started seeing Pete and they kept it secret from Andy.

evidence.snippet: Erin: Yes. Pete and I have started seeing each other and Andy still doesn't know.

beats.summary: Pam prepares for a job interview in Philadelphia arranged by Jim.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Jim set up a job interview for me today in Philly.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: It's my aunt Shirley, she's on her last legs.
